title: [Peek] Add preview support for EML and MSG email files

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The pinned Job Object helper compiled under Windows PowerShell 5.1. The parent-exits-while-a-descendant-remains, timeout-and-drain, and assigned-but-not-resumed cleanup cases passed. A separate deterministic assignment-failure case also passed: the real Windows assignment call returned invalid-handle error six, and the suspended unassigned process was terminated and waited with numeric exit code one recorded. That case confirms unassigned-process cleanup, not an active-process-zero result from an invalid Job Object. Both validation sequences released their exclusive lock after cleanup. These are launcher-custody checks, not product builds; the pinned product candidate build and full review remain unfinished.
